notes.title: Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between is OUT NOW!
notes.content: [quote][p]Hey Legends, I'm so excited to announce that our game that we've been working on for so long is finally OUT![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646773/793dd954c017fc6db1edbd8f38a75beb206ee1e6.gif"][/img][/p][p]We've been working on The Gardens Between since 2012, and this latest instalment in VR I can honestly say is pretty bloody amazing (It's also a massive expansion of the game, but I'll leave that for a different post). [/p][p]Like okay... the original game released in 2018 was already beautiful, I'm just a programmer on the game.. I've been lucky enough to work with some very talented artists. But there's something about this game in VR that is a whole 'nother experience entirely.[/p][p]The first time I put The Gardens Between on a headset it was just a big island in the middle of my room. I sat down cross-legged on the floor, and it was like "OKAY - this is how it's SUPPOSED to be experienced" - sitting on the floor and being surrounded by this mystical place connected me to my childhood self in a way the flat-screen version of the game never could. Which is exactly what the game is supposed to be about![/p][p]Now, getting the game to actually run on a headset at 4k 90FPS and still retain all of it's original beauty was a multi-year process of continual optimisation, shader refinement, and full render-stack rearchitechuring (yep that's a word).  But boy is it worth it.[/p][p]Stop reading here. Just go play it. Seriously![/p][p][/p][/quote]

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content: [p]We are delighted to announce that [b]Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between will launch August 7th, 2025![/b][/p][p][/p][p]When we first created [i][u][url="https://thegardensbetween.com/"]The Gardens Between[/url][/u][/i], it was a love letter to the friendships we cherished in our childhood, the adventures that shaped us, and the bonds that defined us. Seven years later, with our own children experiencing their own bittersweet friendships, the game has taken on a profound new meaning. Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between, our expansive VR edition reflects this deeper, more personal exploration.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646773/591eb6921a2e96b2f54053ca1fa0bf0049f554cd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A brand-new addition to our story is Arina’s diary. Introduced for the first time in [i]Hidden Memories[/i], the diary began as a gift from her dad when they moved house: a blank canvas to capture a new chapter of life. Soon, it grew beyond Arina alone. After meeting her new neighbor, Frendt, the diary became their shared record of adventures, secrets, and discoveries. By the end of this expanded journey, the diary symbolizes the powerful and fleeting moments of childhood friendships—the kind we remember forever, even after goodbyes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646773/793dd954c017fc6db1edbd8f38a75beb206ee1e6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Creating the diary was deeply personal for us. It’s filled not just with drawings, but with Arina’s moods, dreams, and emotions. Each page captures her evolving world, illuminated by Frendt’s friendship. We poured our own memories and our children’s current experiences into these pages, reflecting the intense feelings of joy, excitement, and heartache that accompany growing up and moving on.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Story Retold[/b][/h3][p]Gameplay in [i]Hidden Memories[/i] also became a way to deeply connect players to Arina and Frendt with experiences only possible in VR. The diary isn't just static art—it’s interactive. Now you can physically hold objects that were once background details, each one infused with meaning and a story waiting to be uncovered. Remember the reckless joy of painting outside the lines, the thrill of inventing your own board games on rainy days, or deciphering secret codes at the museum? We’ve captured those moments, inviting you to relive childhood curiosity and creativity through immersive VR interactions. By stepping directly into these memories and living these experiences, you’ll not only understand Arina and Frendt better, but also rediscover parts of yourself, something uniquely achievable through the interactive nature of video games.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646773/ac3c7cb6158641b8531b6848b7ae47bdb674d28a.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646773/06f626c1ac6cfcc11f27fc41c5573c07e5f39738.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646773/a865f16eb904d3e9dd1a25c14733ebc279072bb6.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]The puzzles we designed specifically for VR were a joy to create, allowing us to revisit and expand the original story like never before. Tactile interactions like assembling toys, digging for dinosaur bones, and crafting friendship bracelets place you directly in Arina and Frendt’s shoes, creating a uniquely emotional connection. It’s our hope that as you bend time and explore these surreal gardens, you’ll feel as close to their journey as we do.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646773/5b0d309264b295cfea4f52157bea4bfb5f0af565.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between[/i] is more than a game—it’s a heartfelt tribute to the friendships that shape who we become. As developers and as parents, revisiting this story has been incredibly meaningful. It’s our way of honoring the powerful, fleeting connections of childhood that we now see mirrored in our own kids’ lives.[/p][p][/p][p]Complemented by Tim Shiel’s ambient soundtrack, [i]Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between[/i] offers hours of meditative puzzle-solving in a vibrant, mesmerising world. The game represents a labor of love from our entire team, bringing together most of the original development team while welcoming new talent to expand this beloved story.[/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait to welcome you into the reimagined world of Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between. [b]Wishlist now to be alerted when the game is available![/b][/p]

notes.title: Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between Announced!
notes.content:
Bend time at will, as childhood best friends Arina and Frendt journey across islands filled with precious mementos from the seminal moments of their time together. Explore a captivating narrative through the lens of virtual reality and solve clever puzzles. Embrace a tale retold in a new light, with twice the content in an illustrious, fully remastered package.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3084870/extras/TGBVR_Teaser_Final_V32.gif?t=1749060730[/img]

We’re so excited to finally share something we’ve been working on for a long time - Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between is a reimagining of our time-bending puzzle game The Gardens Between rebuilt from the ground up for virtual reality. This isn't just a VR port. It's The Gardens Between as you've never seen it before, with double the content and entirely new ways to interact with Arina and Frendt's story.

Making this game has been a really special continuation of the journey we started all the way back in 2011 with the first prototype of a “Minority Report” inspired time manipulation game. Since then, at least three million  people have played The Gardens Between! Members of our original team have scattered throughout the globe and gone on to be part of making so many incredible games. We’re proud that almost the entire original development team reunited for Hidden Memories in some form, bringing the same care and thoughtfulness that made the game special back into this project along with a wealth of new experience. We’ve also been joined by new contributors who’ve brought fresh perspectives and new ideas to The Gardens Between world.

[b]Here’s what you can expect from Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]A fully VR-native experience: [/b]We've completely transformed how you interact with the world. Reach out and physically manipulate time itself.
[*] [b]A new story:[/b] Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between begins two decades after the original story, as Frendt is in the midst of moving. Upon discovering the diary of his childhood best friend, Arina, Frendt is transported back to The Gardens Between, now guided by Arina’s treasured diary.
[*] [b]Over 40 new puzzles: [/b]Handcrafted VR-native puzzles scattered across the levels, offering tangible and immersive interactions only possible in VR. Engage in bespoke puzzles delivering unparalleled emotional depth with real-time physics. Reach out and assemble toy parts, lift a paintbrush to experience a whimsical moment, or playfully craft a friendship bracelet to become part of this intimate world.
[/list]

Watch our reveal trailer here for a look at how we’ve transformed the world for VR:

[previewyoutube=BhfYwF5ApAQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between is coming soon to Steam VR and Meta Quest Store. Whether you're a longtime fan or completely new to the game, we can't wait for you to experience this magical journey in a whole new dimension.

Wishlist now to be notified when Hidden Memories becomes available.
